نبذة

Lash and Brow Avenue! Our beauty salon is a one stop salon. We offer premium beauty services and training, including Lash Extensions, Lash Lifts, Brows, Cosmetic Tattoo, Facials, Makeup and Teeth Whitening. At LBA, we are privileged to be able to offer not just beauty treatments but a space for relaxation, self-expression, and empowerment.

بناءً على 3,086 مراجعة رائعة من العملاء

Rather than taking a one-size-fits-all approach, Lash and Brow Avenue - Ed Square is praised for brow and lash treatments shaped around each client’s preferences. The brow artists listen carefully, offer thoughtful guidance and work with precision on services such as brow lamination and lash lifts, while their gentle, welcoming manner helps clients feel comfortable and leave delighted with the results.
